summary: Institutional positioning is heavily skewed toward long-term bullishness in mega-cap tech and broad market indices, evidenced by massive call premiums in AMZN ($1.3B+), MU (P/C 0.28), and NVDA (P/C 0.13). Significant directional conviction is visible in AMZN LEAPS, specifically the 275C, 250C, and 300C strikes for Jan 2027, totaling over $1.1B in single-day accumulations. Persistent institutional interest is concentrated in massive SPX call clusters, notably the 6000C and 7000C strikes for 2026 and 2027 expirations, representing tens of billions in multi-day positioning. Traders should watch for continued upward momentum in AMZN and MU, while monitoring if SPX price action tests the support levels implied by the heavy 2026/2027 call accumulation.
